pages.title: Multiple Choice Question
pages.content:
What will be the output of this code?

```go
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	num := []int{10, 4, 2, 20}
	num[1] = 20
	num[2] = 10
	fmt.Println(num[1])
}

```
